description:
**Original Webtoon:**  
[Daum](https://webtoon.kakao.com/content/Go-Bananas/1899), [KakaoPage](https://page.kakao.com/content/53491650)

"Who on earth are you?" It is the same old blocked call that always comes in. No matter how much I vent my anger or beg over the phone, there is no answer. Is it the woman who heartlessly abandoned me two months ago? Or... Although every day is tormented because I cannot forget her, my daily life flows slowly as I participate in the mysterious 'Baduk Research Club,' dance the lively Cha-Cha-Cha, or watch a chaotic magic show. Will I ever be able to forget those suspicious calls from the past that bind me and move forward?
